allowed: Complete reliable current-frame current/max caption in verified same-frame resource-bar geometry
Separately verified operator configuration with explicit character/session/maximum-change validity; no such configured maximum currently supplied
disallowed: Infer maximum from level/vocation or a full-looking bar
Use resource annotations or previous decoded values
Use a clipped caption suffix or duplicate current number as a primary fallback
maximum_policy.caption_self_consistency: Both numbers must pass existing accelerated_fast acceptance with touching-digit enumeration disabled; current<=max and max>0; current/max must also intersect measured fill interval allowing one integer quantum. Otherwise no independent maximum.
maximum_policy.binding: FreshMaximum matches field, current frame timestamp, complete RGB+size token, and current layout fingerprint. These bind observations together but do not themselves prove live capture freshness.

focused_caption_parser.method: Manually boxed component transfer checks, not autonomous geometry discovery or a full benchmark. Inputs are original pixels. min(R,G,B) suppresses green/blue backgrounds; one complete diagonal slash, blank boundaries, whole-caption centering, digit baseline and all-foreground checks precede both numeric reads. Final numeric backend uses accelerated_fast with touching-digit partition enumeration disabled; ordinary acceptance and bounded scale/threshold corroboration remain unchanged.
generated_safety_categories: Extra foreground and erased leading digit
Invalid current/max ordering and zero maximum
Stale geometry, changed pixels at same timestamp, unsupported fields and invalid bounds
Explicit guard forbids combinatorial touching-digit fallback in optionalcaption reader

performance_refinement.trigger: Optional BJEI caption parsing exceeded the full-pipeline100ms target; touching-digit fallback repeated combinatorial glyph preparation.
performance_refinement.before: accelerated_robust plus touching-digit search and outer4brightness-consensus retries
performance_refinement.after: accelerated_fast without touching-digit search; no cached numeric result or weakened acceptance thresholds
performance_refinement.scope: Local provisional component-pair algorithm timing only, original BJEI pixels;50 interleaved repetitions afterone warmup; OpenCVthreads1; excludes discovery, geometry, framehash, capture/copy and completepipeline. No native latency claim.

evaluation_limits_and_next_steps: Preserve first-original-frame accuracy; report repeated identical originals with manufactured timestamps as latency/control evidence only.
Require independently reviewed real changing full frames to measure temporal benefit, stale output, onset delay, occlusion and capture restart behavior. No such native sequence is available here.
Use source identity and paired chrome to avoid monster health, XP, stamina, training, central curved HUD and sidebar-mini-bar confusion.
Bar fill is quantized and approximate. Nearby integer candidates can share the same fill; report N/A when numeric competition remains unresolved.
Maxima can change; old values must not be carried across character/session/scale/geometry changes. Missing maximum means no numerical bar veto.
Keep cross-source reading capability separate from existing Skills-row association scoring.
A passing guard XML must be bound to its execution revision and implementation/test hashes before an aggregate report treats it as matching safety evidence.
